context: The WebAgents project has reached a working prototype with a portable signed agent.pkg format, an OpenClaw-based browser/runtime, and two reference agents: Meeting Agenda and Literature Review. The team is preparing the final workshop paper and wants to decide which remaining experiments, implementation checks, and paper revisions are necessary before submission.
goal: Agree on the final set of experiments and paper revisions required before submission, identify the highest-priority remaining tasks, and leave the meeting with a concrete action plan.
